notes.title: Eternal Realm II coming soon
notes.content:
Here is the link to the game's sequel that comes out in 2 weeks: https://store.steampowered.com/app/974930/Eternal_Realm_II_Dark_Matter/

It improves upon the old formula and fixes many of the old issues with the game and actually has a story line this time around!

notes.title: Eternal Realm released
notes.content:
Realm of Perpetual Guilds has been re-named to "Eternal Realm" and released as a free game. All sequels will use this new franchise name.

This new version of Eternal Realm has heavy adjustments made to the game difficulty as well as some changes to abilities. The biggest difference is the increase of Stamina recovery rates and the Rest command is more useful now. There are also some adjustments to the game text. These new changes should make the game more accessible and enjoyable. 


Eternal Realm II: Dark Matter will hopefully be released on Steam around early January.  This game will take on a more serious tone than the original, which was more of a satire.

notes.title: Switching to Free Game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I decided to just make this game open to the public and "free". I will also be updating the game in the near future, mostly fixing the difficulty level. I will be doing this for my other game as well. 

Afterwards, I will release "Dark Matter", the sequel to this game.

notes.title: Reviews greatly appreciated
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

RPG has been on Steam for 4 months now and it has almost no reviews. If you liked the game (or even if you didn't) can you please write a short review? Just write what you honestly thought about the game. It doesn't have to be long.

Thanks.

notes.title: RPG II: "The Game of Games" coming to Steam Greenlight very soon.
notes.content:
The player characters of guild #1337 are now on a quest to find out the cause of the abyss that is destroying their world. 

Same battle system but, now with 10 playable characters and a more in-depth
storyline. More details coming soon. 


P.S. Realm of Perpetual Guilds' price is dropping to $1.99 very soon.
